g.text: B Structural fraction in each cohort

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 2,784 valid partial inputs have no learned certificate

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Exact structural census over all 836,069 valid N15 inputs; this is not a search-accuracy measurement.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Unchanged full-N14 hybrid and supplied oracle · 32,516 complete superqueen solutions · 1–3 given queens

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: All 2,784 unsupported cases have three clues. Every valid one- or two-clue input has a certificate.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: The hybrid admits 17,462,500 of 18,696,700 compatible valid input–completion certificates.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: The oracle admits every compatible completion. This census uses no GPU searches and changes no model.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: A valid certificate may exist without finite search finding it. A fallback decoder may succeed without a certificate.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Conditional soundness of stopped boards therefore differs from certificate availability and measured search accuracy.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Full population counts are exact for this finite universe; cohort bars show exact subset counts, not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Post hoc descriptive diagnostic, independently crosschecked against literal margins and both prior cohort audits.
